content:
[L] high | bottom ~60% of window | entire region is solid black dead space below the table — content area does not fill the window or renders as an empty void, reading as a rendering bug
[L] high | top-left corner | "Customers" heading is clipped at the window edge with no top padding, text touching the frame border
[L] med | top-right | "Sync now" button is clipped by the window edge and the "4 customers (of 4)" label sits flush against it with no separation
[S] high | table columns | numeric "Conversations" values are right-aligned against the column edge while all other columns are left-aligned, creating an inconsistent alignment scheme
[S] med | "Open" button column | buttons float with huge trailing whitespace to the right edge of the table, no defined last-column boundary
[S] med | search bar row | search field is inset from left edge but the table below extends nearly edge-to-edge, so toolbar and table do not share a left grid line
[C] high | bottom two-thirds of screen | wasted empty black region while all content is crushed into the top ~300px — severely unbalanced composition
[H] med | header row | column headers (NAME, EMAIL...) in small all-caps gray carry near-equal weight with body rows; no visual anchor or row hover affordance visible
[H] med | "Customers" title | page title is small and visually no stronger than body text; no hierarchy between title, toolbar, and table
[H] low | "Open" buttons | four identical small bordered buttons repeated at equal weight with no primary action differentiation
[C] low | "4 customers (of 4)" | redundant "4 of 4" count reads like debug output rather than product copy
[S] low | row heights | table rows are uniform but the table has no visible bottom edge before the black void, so the panel boundary is undefined

VERDICT: unprofessional — a small crushed table sitting on top of a giant black void with a clipped title and clipped sync button reads as a broken debug build, not a product.
